An '''honor rigora''' was a type of [[rigora]]. In an honor rigora a dishonored pirate was allowed to fight to regain his honor by facing a champion of the accused's choosing.<ref name="Zirtran's Anchor (article)">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
